payload.title: Accounts Payable Coordinator
payload.description:
The Accounts Payable Coordinator owns the day-to-day process for paying interpreters, translators, and other vendors accurately, on time, and according to approved terms. This role maintains reliable financial records, resolves discrepancies, and gives the Director of Finance and Accounting clear visibility into upcoming payments. We expect initiative, careful judgment, and consistent follow-through so routine accounts payable work moves forward with minimal supervision.

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time.

Strong English communication skills are required.

Responsibilities:

  • Invoice Review and Processing:
    • Receive, review, and enter vendor invoices in QuickBooks Online, maintaining accurate dates, due dates, amounts, expense coding, and supporting records.
    • Match charges to approved vendor rates, assignment or project records, completed services, and applicable approvals. Verify hours, fees, reimbursements, and adjustments.
    • Identify duplicate invoices, incorrect charges, and missing information. Work with vendors and internal teams to resolve discrepancies before payment.
  • Payment Coordination:
    • Prepare payment schedules and batches according to approved terms, established payment cycles, and the Director's cash-planning guidance.
    • Obtain required approvals, process authorized payments through approved systems, and retain payment confirmations and a clear approval record.
    • Track overdue, failed, rejected, or returned payments. Follow each issue through resolution and communicate updates before avoidable delays affect vendors.
  • Vendor Records and Communication:
    • Maintain accurate vendor profiles, payment terms, contact information, and required onboarding and tax documentation. Coordinate missing items with the responsible team.
    • Verify new or changed banking instructions through the approved verification process before use. Protect vendor banking details and confidential company information.
    • Respond professionally to payment questions. Work with interpreting and translation teams to clarify service details, resolve disputes, and keep vendors informed.
  • Reconciliation and Close Support:
    • Reconcile vendor statements, invoices, payments, credits, and outstanding balances. Investigate differences and record approved corrections accurately.
    • Complete assigned accounts payable reconciliations and help reconcile the accounts payable balance to the general ledger. Escalate unexplained differences.
    • Support month-end close by organizing records and identifying completed services with missing invoices or unrecorded costs for the accounting team's review.
  • Reporting and Process Improvement:
    • Maintain current accounts payable aging and upcoming-payment reports. Highlight overdue balances, unresolved discrepancies, and expected cash outflows for the Director.
    • Keep procedures, payment calendars, and open-item records current so an authorized backup can understand payment status and required next steps.
    • Identify recurring errors, manual work, and avoidable delays. Recommend practical improvements and collaborate with Finance and Systems on approved automation.
    • Support Accounting team with 13-week cash flow projection and yearly budget.

payload.title: Senior Localization Project Manager
payload.description:
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for managing assigned accounts end-to-end, including project planning, execution, monitoring, delivery, and closure in line with the client processes and tools. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will partner with the Operations Squad Lead to support large enterprise accounts.

This role will serve as the primary project-level contact for clients, building strong customer relationships while collaborating closely with account directors and production teams to maximize delivery performance, client satisfaction, quality, and profitability.

The ideal candidate is a motivated and dependable professional with strong relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams. They should bring the adaptability, resilience, and energy needed to succeed in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and supervise global teams, including internal and external stakeholders, with responsibility for both direct and indirect reports.
  • Prepare, analyze, and implement project plans in alignment with the client standards, including project initiation, workflow management, completion, status updates, invoice approvals, and client information maintenance.
  • Develop and manage detailed project schedules to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
  • Prepare project estimates and proposals for client review and approval.
  • Conduct risk assessments and implement strategic plans to minimize potential issues and ensure successful outcomes.
  • Oversee QA projects, including resource allocation, defect management, reporting, and overall quality performance.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve project and client objectives.
  • Create and maintain process documentation as required.
  • Operate independently with moderate support, proactively identifying and escalating issues outside of scope in a timely manner.
  • Partner with production teams to drive continuous improvement in project delivery, efficiency, and profitability.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including colleagues across departments and vendors.
  • Develop trusted client relationships at the project level, achieving measurable success in customer satisfaction ratings.
  • Ensure clear, effective, and timely communication with all project stakeholders, including clients and production teams.
  • Maintain accuracy and timeliness of all financial systems data.
  • Prepare and deliver reporting, including weekly project status updates, budget-to-actual analysis, time management, and client/vendor-related issues.
  • Protect project profitability through effective margin management.
  • Plan, prepare, and lead quarterly business reviews with clients in face-to-face settings.

payload.title: 3D Game Artist
payload.description:
We're looking for a 3D Game Artist to join a fixed-term project to build a prototype for a new kids' musical instrument learning game. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take a game concept from modeling through to polished, production-ready assets, while helping shape a stylized, child-friendly art direction.

Hybrid work model, based in Munich.
